caption:
Figure 1: Motivation of SegDem. Conventional regression is prone to false colors and moire´ arti-
facts in ambiguous regions, while generative models may hallucinate details unsupported by RAW
measurements. SegDem instead transfers structural decoder representations from segmentation to
demosaicing, improving boundary-aware reconstruction.
